description: Change one tracked application by its id: move its status (in any direction, because the candidate asked), add a note or set the next interview date. Ask the candidate before moving a status based on something you inferred, such as an email. The answer points at what the new stage leads to: prep for an interview, reviews at an offer.

interview_round.description: The interview round; alone, it moves the row to that round.

name: update_application
title: Update an application
